## Problem

Python 3.11 CI intermittently kills an xdist worker after `tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted` hangs in TestClient teardown. Three recent runs hit the 300-second hang guard; Python 3.12/3.13 pass. The exact mechanism and runtime proof are recorded in the Phase 1 RCA comment.

## Proven mechanism

Python 3.11 `asyncio.wait_for` can consume an external worker cancellation when its child future completes in the same turn (CPython issue 86296). The opcert worker then loops back to `queue.get()` with a pending cancellation count, while lifespan awaits it forever. A deterministic harness observed that state; replacing only `wait_for` with Python 3.12-style timeout semantics made the original reproduction pass 20/20.

## Phase 2 plan

- Inventory the existing opcert app coverage and freeze a contract card for prompt lifespan teardown when a job completion collides with shutdown cancellation.
- Add the smallest Python-3.11 regression oracle in `tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py`; prove it RED for the cancellation-completion mechanism before production changes.
- Hold that oracle out from the fixer. Repair the cancellation mechanism in `src/rebar/opcert_service/app.py` while preserving the 202 ACK, terminal record schema, one-worker queue, per-job timeout, and Python 3.12+ behavior.
- Restore the held-out oracle; prove GREEN, seed the exact swallowed-cancellation defect and prove RED again, then restore the fix.
- Run the opcert app/core suites under Python 3.11 and the pinned Python 3.12 environment, plus lint, typecheck, complexity/module-size, and the broader relevant suite.
- Replicate the original lone-test and xdist scenarios; sweep other `asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...))` lifecycle sites and parallel app surfaces for the confirmed pattern.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] A regression oracle is observed RED before the fix and GREEN after it on Python 3.11.
- [x] Shutdown cancellation terminates the opcert worker promptly even when job completion collides with cancellation.
- [x] The held-out oracle returns RED under an exact defect-seeded mutation, then GREEN after restoration.
- [x] The original lone-test and xdist reproductions no longer hang on Python 3.11.
- [x] Existing opcert semantics and Python 3.12+ tests remain green; lint and typecheck pass.
- [x] RCA, proof, caller safety, sibling sweep, and final verification are recorded on this ticket.
